name: LightCMR-Bench
description:
Dataset Card for LightCMR-Bench
	

LightCMR-Bench is a lightweight benchmark for evaluating cross-modal retrieval models using precomputed vision-language embeddings. It is built upon the Localized Narratives dataset and includes two embedding subsets of different dimensionalities to support both high-accuracy and resource-efficient use cases.
